ruleDefinitions.name: Potential SmadHook.DLL Sideloading
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of "SmadHook.dll", a DLL used by SmadAV antivirus Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: (ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\SmadHook32c\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\SmadHook64c\\\.dll$")) AND  NOT (((process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\SMADAV\\SmadavProtect32\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\SMADAV\\SmadavProtect64\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\SMADAV\\SmadavProtect32\.exe" OR process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\SMADAV\\SmadavProtect64\.exe") AND (ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\SMADAV\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\SMADAV\\\\"))))
